recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-16452 unless a future work group decision revisits the separate generic HTTP OPTIONS note introduced by FHIR-17831.
issue_request: FHIR-16452 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core-http change request raised for STU3. It asked whether R4 should be the future release that removed the deprecated use of HTTP OPTIONS to retrieve capabilities, with the resolution to remove OPTIONS as described for meta.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly names FHIR-16452, and the Jira comments say the change was already done under another task. Git history shows commit 6c524e959315a07f484862bbcd627c2ce90a3057 removed the substantive OPTIONS [base] capability retrieval text and deprecation paragraph from source/http.html; FHIR-17322 later recorded the explicit R4 removal task and its cited svn revision 13874 corresponds to commit 996a1f3590fd9b32e1883f47b977b26a3e98234b, which cleaned up a residual hData OPTIONS note.
additional_context: FHIR-9841 first deprecated OPTIONS for conformance/capability retrieval. FHIR-17831 later deliberately added the generic note that, where FHIR does not specify HTTP capabilities such as OPTIONS, implementers should expect only the underlying HTTP protocol behavior. That later note, DICOM Endpoint example verbs, and historical release notes are not stale instructions to use OPTIONS for /metadata. The R4 branch and current source both describe capabilities as GET [base]/metadata only.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source/http.html capabilities section and interaction summary list GET /metadata, source/capabilitystatement/codesystem-capability-statement-kind.xml says the instance kind is returned by /metadata, and targeted searches found no current obsolete instruction to use OPTIONS [base] or OPTIONS to retrieve a CapabilityStatement.
